title: Toward Autonomous RTL and Synthesis Optimization: Benchmarking and Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.13713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and autonomous agents are creating new opportunities for hardware design optimization. This paper examines three connected directions toward autonomous RTL and synthesis optimization: (1) Realistic benchmarking. We discuss reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks that evaluate optimization opportunities under realistic EDA workflows. (2) Tool-grounded RTL optimization. We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills. Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis. (3) Design-specific synthesis optimization. translated_title: 迈向自主RTL与综合优化：基准测试与自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）与自主智能体的最新进展正在为硬件设计优化创造新的机遇。本文探讨了实现自主RTL与综合优化的三个相互关联的方向：（1）现实的基准测试。我们讨论了基于参考的和开放式的RTL优化基准，用以在真实EDA工作流程下评估优化机会。（2）基于工具的RTL优化。我们提出了Dr. RTL，一个多智能体框架，可自动化关键路径分析、RTL重写和实现级评估，并通过可复用的优化技能持续自我改进。在20个真实RTL设计上的评估显示，Dr. RTL相比商业综合工具平均实现了WNS/TNS提升21%/17%，同时面积减少6%。（3）面向特定设计的综合优化。我们探索了智能体驱动的综合脚本调优，以及跨中间表示的可执行综合算法的发现。
tldr: 本文提出迈向自主RTL与综合优化的三个方向，并介绍自我改进的多智能体框架Dr. RTL，其在20个真实设计上相比商业综合工具实现平均WNS/TNS提升21%/17%、面积减少6%。
en_tdlr: This paper outlines three directions toward autonomous RTL and synthesis optimization and introduces Dr. RTL, a self-improving multi-agent framework that achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% with 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis on 20 real-world designs.
